ai_era.title: Project management powered by
ai_era.desc: Not just another task board. Taskosaur empowers your team with intelligent agents to accelerate from ideation to production-ready releases.
ai_era.repel_tip: Move your mouse across the canvas to experience the interactive particle field. Taskosaur deeply integrates with advanced AI models to turn ideas into shipping code.
ai_era.pillar1_title: Embed agents in your existing workflow
ai_era.pillar1_desc: Assign tasks to your favorite coding AI agents directly from Taskosaur. Automatically convert complex user stories into actionable tasks.
ai_era.pillar2_desc: Supply precise project and architectural context before writing code. Help AI reason deeper and produce accurate solutions.
ai_era.pillar3_title: Scale AI responsibly with full control
ai_era.pillar3_desc: Full audit trails and granular organization permissions keep humans and agents aligned in the same direction.

deep_dive.title: More than project management
